name: Lille

queries.query: Lille cadastre officiel parcelles données ouvertes API Cadastre IGN géométrie
queries.result: La Ville de Lille publie une rubrique open data et MEL offre le service cartographique MELMAP. L’API officielle IGN Cadastre, filtrée sur le code communal 59350, a indiqué 60 843 éléments correspondants et renvoyé trois géométries complètes. La requête au point WUP n’a renvoyé aucune parcelle.

queries.query: Lille official cadastral parcels city code 59350 public GeoJSON API IGN
queries.result: Official IGN API returned three full MultiPolygons filtered to Lille commune code 59350. The WUP-point request returned zero; the commune-filtered sample is not a point match or completeness proof.

source.name: France IGN/DGFiP Parcellaire Express (PCI)
source.scope: 281 valid, distinct official cadastral polygons verified in thirteen local 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged WUP settlement locator. Complete pages, forced three-row pagination, all 281 fresh native cadastral-reference reads, valid synthetic absence, footprint and source binding passed. Independent GEOS in EPSG:32631 found no invalid polygons, duplicate geometry, overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. Lille metropolitan settlement locator near Marcq-en-Barœul, which is a separate commune. The initial query restricted to Lille commune 59350 returned no parcel at the WUP point; the existing nationwide IGN provider verifies nearby ground at the unchanged locator without that municipal restriction. Wider municipal completeness, legal boundary accuracy and long-term identifier continuity remain unverified.
source.identityBasis: Fresh bounded adapter qualification uses the publisher native cadastral key, preserving complete geometry and separate transport IDs.
